text: Wherever a person reads a proposal's chart, the dashboard draws it as the poster a merged project's page uses (#784), at @gitdek's request: he couldn't read ask3d#16's chart before ratifying. A proposal's page and an option preview's page show the animated poster, with its still twin for reduced motion, and a proposal's page lists the rules a person would ratify, in plain words, with the bounds. Their cards in Needs you and on /act show the poster instead of the complete evidence image, which stays one link away. The header's updated label also keeps one width, so nothing beside it moves as it ticks (#781).
